criterion: One equal-width is/== operator token; all other source characters unchanged; exactly one unchained AST operator change and no other AST differences. Other metadata/multiple-file/unsupported changes rejected by whole-patch adapter.
legacy_acceptance_preservation_argument: A legacy accepted text diff is exactly one replacement of is with == (or reverse), so lengths are equal, the first differing span is exactly those two characters, and all following characters match.

A legacy accepted token diff replaces one token with one token. Equal token-stream lengths imply the corresponding zipped token streams differ only at that pair. Its source position is the unchanged-character span.
The same AST one-edit, unchained-comparison and whole-AST equivalence checks remain. Thus every legacy accepted decoded-string patch meets the new gate.

legacy_false_rejection_counterexample.before_generator: "".join(f"v{i % 3} = a is None\n" for i in range(18))
legacy_false_rejection_counterexample.edit: Replace only the fourth is token with ==.
legacy_false_rejection_counterexample.legacy: Rejected because SequenceMatcher aligns repeated source differently.
legacy_false_rejection_counterexample.linear: Accepted only after direct text+token+AST validation.

benchmark.criterion: one equal-width is/== token; identical all other characters; exactly one unchained AST operator difference
benchmark.legacy_difference: SequenceMatcher can reject exact valid edits in repeated text; linear gate recovers only explicitly text/token/AST-proved cases.
